title: Connect a Repository

step_connect.heading: Select a Repository
step_connect.description: Choose a repository with an existing Telar site.
step_connect.no_installations: You need to install the Telar Compositor app on your GitHub account before you can connect a repository.
step_connect.install_hint: After installing, come back to this page and refresh to see your repositories.
step_connect.missing_repo_callout_body: The Telar Compositor app only sees repos in accounts and organizations where it's installed. To use a repo from another account or org, install the app there.
step_connect.missing_repo_callout_cta: Install on another account or organization
step_connect.private_repo_warning_body: GitHub Pages doesn't publish private repositories on free GitHub accounts. You can still import this site and work on it here. To publish it, <repoSettings>make the repository public</repoSettings> or use a paid GitHub account. Students may qualify for the free <studentPack>GitHub Student Developer Pack</studentPack>.

installation_scope.title: Grant access to this repository
installation_scope.body: The Telar Compositor GitHub App can't yet see this repository. Click the button below to update the app's access on GitHub, then come back to this page.
installation_scope.waiting: Waiting for access to this repository...

step_sync.heading: Importing Content
step_sync.error_not_telar: This doesn't appear to be a Telar site.
step_sync.error_empty_repo: This repository is empty. Select one with an existing Telar site.
step_sync.error_already_connected: This repository is already connected. To re-import it, unlink it first from the repository list.
step_sync.error_colliding_columns: The sheet "{{sheet}}" has columns Telar reads as one ({{columns}}), and each of them has values. Telar can't build the site from a sheet like this, so it wasn't imported. Keep only the column you want, delete the others from the sheet on GitHub or in Google Sheets, and then import the site again.
step_sync.error_sheet_unreadable: We couldn't read the sheet "{{sheet}}" from GitHub, so the site wasn't imported. Try again in a moment.
step_sync.error_file_unreadable: We couldn't read the file "{{file}}" from GitHub, so the site wasn't imported. Try again in a moment.
step_sync.error_ignore_list_unreadable: We couldn't read the list of stories you chose to ignore from GitHub, so the site wasn't imported. Try again in a moment.
step_sync.error_no_main_branch: This repository's default branch is "{{branch}}", but the Compositor works on a branch named "main". The Compositor can rename "{{branch}}" to "main" and then import the site.
step_sync.error_main_beside_default: This repository's default branch is "{{branch}}", but its "main" branch, the one the Compositor works on, also holds a Telar site. The Compositor can make "main" the default branch and then import the site from it.
step_sync.error_main_not_site: This repository's default branch is "{{branch}}", and its "main" branch does not hold a Telar site. The Compositor works only on "main", so the site needs to be on "main" before it can be imported.
step_sync.error_main_unreadable: We couldn't read the "main" branch of this repository on GitHub. Try again in a moment.
step_sync.error_rename_pending: GitHub is still renaming the branch. Try again in a moment.
step_sync.error_branch_admin_required: Only an admin of this repository can change its default branch. Ask an admin to import the site.
step_sync.make_main_default: Make main the default and import
step_sync.warning_pages_old_branch: The site's branch is now "main", but GitHub Pages still publishes it from "{{branch}}". In the repository's Pages settings on GitHub, choose GitHub Actions as the source.
step_sync.error_sheets_access: Could not access the published Google Sheet. Please provide the correct URL.

step_review.heading: Import Complete
step_review.config_explanation: Your site's configuration was imported from your repository. You can review and adjust key settings now — such as the site title and description that appear on your landing page, the color theme, the language, and the URL where your site is published. If everything looks right in the summary above, you can skip this step — all settings are available later from the Config tab.

step_done.heading: You're All Set!
step_done.description: Your Telar site has been imported successfully.
step_done.created_description: Your new Telar site is ready. We set everything up for you — no manual configuration needed.
step_done.first_build_note: The first build is in progress. Your site will be live in a few minutes at:

inline_config.heading: Essential Settings
inline_config.baseurl_help: Path prefix for GitHub Pages project sites (e.g. /my-repo)

site_config.heading: Checking your site configuration
site_config.intro: Let's make sure everything is set up correctly before you start working. Don't worry — the Compositor can fix any issues for you.
site_config.sheets_failed: Google Sheets needs to be disabled
site_config.sheets_why: The Compositor manages your content directly. Google Sheets must be disabled so the two don't conflict during builds. We'll disable it for you.
site_config.sheets_reversible: You can switch back to Google Sheets at any time by setting enabled: true under google_sheets in your site's _config.yml.
site_config.pages_why: Your site needs GitHub Pages to be published. Without it, your site won't be accessible and IIIF tiles can't be generated. We'll switch it on for you.
site_config.url_failed: Site URL needs to be updated
site_config.url_pending: Site URL can't be verified yet
site_config.check_failed: We couldn't check your site's GitHub Pages settings. We'll keep trying.
site_config.url_why: The URL in _config.yml must match your GitHub Pages deployment so IIIF image tiles load from the correct address.
site_config.url_pending_why: We'll configure the correct URL automatically when we enable GitHub Pages. If there is an issue we'll correct it.
site_config.error_pages_permission: The Compositor needs permission to enable GitHub Pages on your repository. Accept the updated permissions in your GitHub App settings, then try again.
site_config.error_generic: We couldn't fix the configuration. Please try again, or check your GitHub App permissions.
site_config.error_private_repo: GitHub Pages can't be switched on for a private repository on a free GitHub account. Make the repository public, or use a paid GitHub account, then try again.

form.title: Create a new Telar site
form.name_hint: Letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, and underscores. Must not start with a dot or hyphen.
form.title_hint: Shown as your site's name. You can change it later.
form.description_hint: A short line shown in search results and link previews.
form.kind_site_hint: An exhibition site with stories built on a collection of objects.
form.kind_course_hint: A shared collection for a class. Student sites join it with a code and receive its objects.
form.course_code_hint: If your instructor gave you a code, enter it here to join their course and receive its collection.

errors.repo_name_taken: A repository with this name already exists on your account. Choose a different name.
errors.permission_denied: The Telar Compositor GitHub App needs permission to create repositories. Update the app's permissions in your GitHub settings and try again.
errors.github_error: Something went wrong talking to GitHub. Please try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_name: This name isn't valid. Use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, and underscores. It must not start with a dot or hyphen.
errors.name_exists: A repository with this name already exists on your account.

progress.heading: Setting up your new site
progress.setting_up_detail: Creating the repository, writing your configuration and starter content, and starting the first build.
progress.setting_up_degraded: Your site was created with default settings — we'll finish configuring it in the next step.
progress.setting_up_scope: Your site was created — we need access to your new repository on GitHub to finish setting it up.
progress.still_setting_up: Your site is still being set up. Reload the page to continue.

installation_scope.title: Grant access to your new site
installation_scope.body: The Telar Compositor GitHub App needs permission to see your new repository before you can start editing. Click the button below to update the app's access on GitHub, then come back to this page.
installation_scope.waiting: Waiting for access to your new repository...

account_modal.title: Choose where to create your site
account_modal.description: Pick the account or organization where the new repository should live.
account_modal.install_elsewhere_hint: Don't see your organization? The Compositor only lists accounts where it's already installed.

inline_url_help: Your GitHub Pages or custom domain URL
